Hi, my name is jorn.
I would love to strenghten your knife server admin pool, because i feel there aren't enough active admins for this server.
I play the server daily and rearly see one.. This makes the server somewhat chaotic.. A lot of players neglecting the rules even when these are simple ones like 1v1 only, no racism.. etc..


I really love this server and several people on it so that's why i'm leaving my application here for you to discuss.


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
De Weird jorn is my real name. And my ingame name is Alucard.


2) How old are you?
22


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
As stated above the application.. I really like playing on it and want to make sure the server stays active, improves and keeps it players happy but in a safe environment without griefers, trollers and racism.


4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
To be honest not that long, a month.. But many to come.


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
Woodworking, forum creeping, Music ofcourse but most importantly visiting and chilling with my friends online or offline.


6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
I am mature when you need to be mature, I see myself as an easy going person looking for fun and jokes. But if you cross the line of being rude instead of funny, I will act as a mature human being ofcourse.


I think being "mature" is so relative to the context.
I hope you get what i mean?


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
I have been an admin on minecraft servers, Co-leader in several guild in multiple MMORPG's.
I see myself as an supporting role in keeping order.


[Bild] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
Mostly from 16/4pm to 1AM, sometimes till 5am. Sometimes in the morning, its very flexible. But my steam is on 24/7.


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
Depends on what pre-history they have, if this has been going on for a while i would take actions and give them both a time out.
If this is a new problem, I would hear out both party's before i jump to conclusions.


I always give a warning first, because come on? haven't you ever scold someone because you are annoyed they are doing better then you?
But if they keep ignoring the warnings, I would swing with the Ban hammer. And the ban time would depend on the actions they took.


10) Strengths
I worked as an animator for groups 7 to 65 years old.
I know my way around people, the internet and trolls.


11) Weaknesses
It would be a weakness to tell your weaknesses..
No i don't really know i always find these types of questions pretty dull, no offence but you can only know someones weaknesses or strenghts by seeing them how they do theyre job instead of them telling you.


12) Conclusion / Closing remark
My conclusion is just.. I don't really care if you pick me or someone else but please, this server needs it's admins and rules because its in chaos sometimes. And me and other people wouldn't want to be forced to leave this good server because of people ignoring the rules.


Thank you for your time,


Have a nice day!
De Weird Jorn

thats an application, maybe rework your application, it looks like you took 20 seconds and paste something fast together.

Since you've removed your application, you are unfortunately being rejected.
We still thank you for trying to support the dream servers.
